data.name: Udalric
data.long_meaning: Derived from Old High German 'Uthala' (people) and 'ric' (ruler). In Christian tradition, Udalric was a bishop and abbot, known for his strong leadership and devotion to his community.
data.spiritual_meaning: Symbol of strong spiritual leadership and community devotion.

in_hebrew.name: אודלריק
in_hebrew.meaning: אודלריק - שפע כוח רוחני, עשיר בכוח אלוהי
in_hebrew.long_meaning: אודלריק הוא שם נוצרי שמקורו בשפה הגרמנית, מורכב מהרכיבים 'אוד' ו-'ריק', שפירושם 'שפע' ו-'שליט' או 'מושל', בהתאמה. שם זה מתאר אדם שופע כוח רוחני, עשיר בכוח אלוהי, ומשמש כמזכרת לחשיבות השפע הרוחני בנצרות.

in_greek.name: Ουδαλρίκος
in_greek.meaning: Ουδαλρίκος - πλούσιος σε πνευματική δύναμη, ισχυρός στην πίστη
in_greek.long_meaning: Ουδαλρίκος είναι ένα Χριστιανικό όνομα που προέρχεται από τη Γερμανική γλώσσα, αποτελούμενο από τα συστατικά 'Odal' και 'ric', που σημαίνουν 'πλούσιος' και 'κυρίαρχος' ή 'άρχων', αντίστοιχα. Αυτό το όνομα περιγράφει ένα άτομο πλούσιο σε πνευματική δύναμη, ισχυρό στην πίστη, και χρησιμεύει ως υπενθύμιση της σημασίας της πνευματικής πλούτου στον Χριστιανισμό.

in_latin.name: Udalricus
in_latin.meaning: Udalricus - potens in virtute, dives in spiritu
in_latin.long_meaning: Udalricus est nomen Christianum quod originem in lingua Germanica habet, compositum ex componentibus 'Odal' et 'ric', quae significant 'dives' et 'dominator' vel 'princeps', respective. Hoc nomen describit hominem potentem in virtute, divitem in spiritu, et servit ad memoriam de importentia divitiarum spiritualium in Christianismo.

in_english.name: Udalric
in_english.meaning: Rich in spiritual power, powerful ruler
in_english.long_meaning: Udalric is a Christian name of Germanic origin, derived from the components 'odal' meaning 'prosperity' or 'riches' and 'ric' meaning 'ruler' or 'king'. This name signifies a person rich in spiritual power, a powerful ruler in faith, and serves as a reminder of the importance of spiritual wealth in Christian tradition. It reflects a strong, faith-driven personality and is associated with leadership qualities and a deep spiritual life.

historical_references.reference: Udalric was a Frankish bishop in the sixth century who is best known for his role in the conversion of the Visigoths to Catholicism. He became the bishop of Nantes in 570, and in 580, he was sent to Spain to continue the missionary work begun by Saint Leander of Seville. Udalric made significant progress in converting the Visigoths, particularly in the area of present-day Catalonia. He was also known for his efforts to bring peace between the Franks and the Visigoths.

Udalric was also a Frankish bishop in the late seventh century who is remembered for his role in the Frisian mission. He was the bishop of Le Mans from 681 to 706 and is credited with preaching the gospel to the Frisians in the area of present-day the Netherlands. Udalric's work was part of a larger missionary effort led by Saint Willibrord, who himself had been sent to the Frisians by Saint Boniface. Udalric's efforts were successful in converting many Frisians to Christianity.
